name: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd
title: Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd - 543271 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue Rs 1,179 crore (+12% YoY) and EBITDA Rs 172 crore, led by Specialty; supply discipline is not discussed, while acetyls spreads face a likely inventory-driven fall after Q1.

utilisation.quote: we run our plants at 90% plus utilization levels

capex.peers_comment: Chinese Pyridine plants run at 30%, 40% utilization levels
capex.quote: we will continue with the range of Rs. 400 crore to Rs. 500 crore of yearly capex

triggers.label: Pyridine capacity 90%+ utilised; China 30-40%
triggers.quote: The plants in China typically run at 30%, 40% utilization levels

triggers.label: Acetic acid prices falling; acetyls spreads to normalise
triggers.quote: we are already seeing acetic acid prices coming down

triggers.label: EBITDA growth at least 20% YoY FY27
triggers.quote: we aspire to get at least 20% year-on-year growth in EBITDA on the full year basis

triggers.label: Big agro contract visibility only for Q1
triggers.quote: So far, they gave us the visibility for first quarter of volumes

guidance.quote: we will stick to our overall guidance of achieving at least 20% growth in EBITDA through the year
we will continue with the range of Rs. 400 crore to Rs. 500 crore of yearly capex
the sustainable margin for our Specialty Chemical portfolio as a whole should be between 23% to 25%

red_flags.label: Agro CDMO customer volume visibility limited to Q1
red_flags.quote: So far, they gave us the visibility for first quarter of volumes

red_flags.label: Acetyls inventory gain likely to reverse
red_flags.quote: whatever inventory impact has to come, we will be able to nullify within this quarter or at best in the early part of next quarter

evasions.quote: So that is why we do not give that guidance.
We are discussing with them about various volume scenarios for rest of the year.
it will not be just as linear, as you said
